description: The server's own page, on 127.0.0.1, may ask its window to print, for a new window, to save a download, for where to save a sent project, to choose a folder or a file, to confirm a line, to keep its settings, for Open Recent, for File's Project History, to zoom, for Undo and Redo in a field, to say the line at the foot to a screen reader on Linux, to close, for its updates, and for the shared copies the app was asked to open, and nothing else
